description.subtitle: Joan Garcia's Nike home goalkeeper long-sleeved jersey for FC Barcelona 2026 2027 - green
description.tagline: Prepared for the big stops of the future
description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona 26/27 Dri-FIT Stadium children's goalkeeper shirt is designed for young goalkeepers to defend the Blaugrana goal in total comfort. Inspired by the official kit used by FC Barcelona goalkeepers during the 2026/2027 season, it presents a striking green color that provides maximum visibility on the pitch.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT: Helps wick away sweat to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Long sleeve: Greater coverage and protection during game actions.
Official goalkeeper design: Inspired by the kit used by FC Barcelona goalkeepers.
Light and breathable fabric: Promotes freedom of movement and comfort.

Inspirada en la equipación oficial utilizada por los porteros del FC Barcelona durante la temporada 2026/2027, presenta un llamativo color verde que aporta máxima visibilidad sobre el terreno de juego.
